title: browser.request
description: Bridge -> host. Asks the host to perform one browser operation. Answered by exactly one browser.response with the same req_id. Unknown fields must be ignored by receivers.

req_id.description: Unique per request, generated by the bridge. Shares its id space with browser.handover.

op.description: Operation. Hosts answer values they do not implement with error code unknown_op, so the schema does not restrict this to an enum.

timeout_ms.description: Advisory: the bridge's own deadline in milliseconds. Hosts must not depend on it.

url.description: open only. Absolute http or https URL.

ref.description: click and type. Element ref from the most recent snapshot, as the host issued it (e.g. r1). Any bridge-side batch prefix such as s7r1 is stripped before sending (see PROTOCOL.md section 9.1).

text.description: type only. Replaces the field's whole value. Empty string clears the field. Not trimmed.

submit.description: type only. Only the JSON value true means 'press Enter after typing'; any other value means no Enter.

dir.description: scroll only. 'up' or 'down'; other values are refused by the host with invalid_argument.
